utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Will the Registrar please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, this is the case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic, Ljubisa Beara, Drago Nikolic, Radivoje Miletic, Milan Gvero, and Vinko Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And the appearances, for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOLJAN
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, my name is Lada Soljan, and I'm appearing for the Prosecution together with my co-counsel, Michael Duttwiler, and my Case Manager, Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And for the Defence, counsel for Mr. Popovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, my name is Zoran Zivanovic. I'm here on behalf of Mr. Vujadin Popovic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. For Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, John Ostojic on behalf of Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thanks. Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Jelena Nikolic and Mr. Stephane Bourgon appearing on behalf of Mr. Drago Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, Natacha Fauveau-Ivanovic as counsel for General Miletic. I'm sorry this microphone doesn't work so ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And I'm also very sorry not to be able to see you very clearly because of the column. Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Your Honour, Peter Haynes, representing Vinko Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Haynes. And I understand that Mr. Gvero's counsel is present.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, good morning. Dragan Krgovic appearing for General Gvero.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: May we move into private session so I can provide an update on the work in this case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: To complete the status of pending motions, Mr. Radovan Karadzic filed a motion before this Chamber publicly on the 27th of September seeking to modify a delayed disclosure decision of the Trial Chamber in this case. The Prosecution filed a response on the 30th of September. No reply has been filed by Mr. Karadzic, and the Chamber will now proceed to decide the motion. May I now ask the appellants whether they wish to raise any concerns regarding their health or the conditions of their detention. Mr. Popovic? THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have nothing to say. I have no objections for the time being.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Popovic. Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] I have nothing to say. No objections, no requests, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Beara. Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I have no objections.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Your Honours, no objections for the time being.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the detention conditions are fine. And as for my health, it's pretty good. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, I'm very glad to hear that, Mr. Pandurevic. May I ask whether there are any other matters to be raised by the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. SOLJAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, the Prosecution has no matters to raise at this time. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Any members of the Defence? There being no other matters to be raised, the hearing is adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
